name: Time-lapse
one_line: A long period compressed into seconds: a clock, strip or interface running fast through a day
summary: A span of hours or days is played in moments, shown by a clock hand sweeping, a schedule strip scrolling or an interface passing through its states. It lets the viewer feel a whole day elapse and see what changes across it. Fast circular or striped motion can alias into stutter or apparent reversal, and the pace needs to stay even so the span reads true.

routes.one_line: Scroll a schedule strip or turn a clock hand with seeked Web Animations API tweens

steps.does: Animate strip position or hand rotation across the compressed span from t

limits: Evidence covers transform tweens, not many-state interface changes along one span
A hand turning fast enough to alias at the delivery frame rate is not tested

routes.one_line: Run a clock, strip and state changes on one seekable Anime.js timeline

steps.does: Sequence hand, strip and state changes on one timeline across the compressed span

limits: Evidence covers transform tween, SVG draw and stagger, not long multi-track timelines
Springs are outside the evidence, so any easing at the ends must be built from eased tweens

routes.one_line: Redraw a clock face or strip on a 2D canvas, with time mapped from t

steps.does: Map scene time to clock time and draw the face, hands or strip each seek

limits: Evidence includes a changing time readout, not a full clock face with fast-turning hands
No motion blur is supplied; fast hands and thin ticks can strobe or shimmer

source: references/data-visualisation §2.4, references/motion-director §7; tool records as of 2026-11-20
